minor.issue: No DELETE endpoint exists (returns 405). Test-created TEST_PrivacyToggle_* / TEST_JoinPublic_* leagues from prior runs accumulate in /public-leagues forever. Consider adding a commissioner-only DELETE for cleanup, or filtering TEST_-prefixed leagues from /public-leagues by default.

ui_bugs.issue: After Confirm Join completes and the success toast fires, the SPA navigates to `/` which renders the unauthenticated marketing landing page (Sign In / Get Started), even though the session is still valid. User has to manually click Sign In or browser-back to get back to the app. Expected behaviour is to either stay on /league-search (with the joined card now showing 'Already a member') or navigate to /dashboard.

issues: Leftover TEST_PrivacyToggle_* and TEST_JoinPublic_* leagues from prior backend test runs are visible at the top of the user-facing list (sorted by created_at DESC). Real seeded leagues are pushed below the test fixtures. This is the same root cause as the missing DELETE endpoint.

action_items: (MEDIUM) Fix post-join navigation in /app/frontend/src/lovable/pages/LeagueSearch.tsx so that after a successful POST /leagues/{id}/join-public the user lands on /dashboard (or stays on /league-search with refreshed already_member badges) instead of the marketing landing page at `/`.
(LOW) Add a commissioner-only DELETE /api/leagues/{id} endpoint OR have /public-leagues filter out leagues with name starting with 'TEST_' to keep the search list clean while running e2e tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L894: query uses {is_private: {$ne: True}} — correctly includes legacy docs missing the field. Good.
server.py L854-857: PUT /leagues/{id} permission check correctly admits commissioner OR co-commissioner. Audit log diff captures from/to values. Good.

server.py L943: full-check uses `>=` against max_teams — correct. Increment of current_teams happens AFTER the team insert (L962), so concurrent joins could over-fill. Low-likelihood race, not blocking.
server.py L962: db.leagues.update_one uses {$inc: {current_teams: 1}} — atomic, but the read-then-write check at L943 is not transactional. Acceptable for MVP.
LeagueSearch.tsx: post-join handler should navigate('/dashboard') or call refetch() and close the dialog rather than letting the SPA bounce to the marketing page.
